# offramp-v2

> The sovereign chat-history off-ramp — a dead vendor JSON export → live searchable memory. Content-addressed (cross-vendor dedupe proven), versioned extraction, the wisp over your own thinking-history. Runs in your browser. Proof-of-play CLEAN 60/60.

offramp-v2 is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
